personality-tendency-definition_35db4d88.name: Risk approach
personality-tendency-definition_35db4d88.description: How a person tends to approach uncertainty and exposure to loss.

expressions.label: Risk-seeking
expressions.description: Often accepts uncertainty for a possible gain.

personality-tendency-definition_cc3599b3.name: Response tempo
personality-tendency-definition_cc3599b3.description: How quickly a person tends to react when circumstances change.

expressions.label: Patient
expressions.description: Often waits for more context before reacting.

expressions.label: Reactive
expressions.description: Often responds quickly to immediate circumstances.

personality-tendency-definition_0695adac.name: Conflict approach
personality-tendency-definition_0695adac.description: How a person tends to engage interpersonal or political conflict.

expressions.label: Conflict-averse
expressions.description: Often seeks to reduce direct confrontation.

expressions.label: Combative
expressions.description: Often accepts or initiates direct confrontation.

personality-tendency-definition_167ac1b0.name: Curiosity
personality-tendency-definition_167ac1b0.description: A unipolar tendency to seek unfamiliar information or experience.

expressions.label: Curious
expressions.description: Often seeks additional information and novel context.

personality-tendency-definition_44505984.name: Loyalty tendency
personality-tendency-definition_44505984.description: A tendency to preserve commitments to people or groups.

expressions.label: Loyal
expressions.description: Often gives established commitments special weight.

personality-tendency-definition_cd77b60b.name: Ambition
personality-tendency-definition_cd77b60b.description: A tendency to pursue advancement or consequential achievement.

expressions.label: Ambitious
expressions.description: Often pursues greater responsibility or achievement.

world-metric-definition_a019e54dacfb0a89.name: Resident population
world-metric-definition_a019e54dacfb0a89.description: Canonical resident population at an explicit point in time.
world-metric-definition_a019e54dacfb0a89.aggregationNote: May be summed only across caller-proven disjoint geographic scopes.

world-metric-definition_193560c4f916be4f.name: Employment rate
world-metric-definition_193560c4f916be4f.description: Employment share measured over an explicit interval.
world-metric-definition_193560c4f916be4f.aggregationNote: Rates require denominator-aware derivation and cannot be summed directly.

world-metric-definition_86372c4e9b915699.name: Aggregate personal income
world-metric-definition_86372c4e9b915699.description: Exact aggregate personal income over an explicit interval.
world-metric-definition_86372c4e9b915699.aggregationNote: May be summed only for the same currency, period, and disjoint scopes.

world-metric-definition_d2710452d3a27d11.name: Labor force
world-metric-definition_d2710452d3a27d11.description: Canonical labor-force population at a point in time.
world-metric-definition_d2710452d3a27d11.aggregationNote: May be summed only across caller-proven disjoint scopes at the same point.

world-metric-definition_2c5ca094ee469ed1.name: Employed population
world-metric-definition_2c5ca094ee469ed1.description: Canonical employed labor-force population at a point in time.
world-metric-definition_2c5ca094ee469ed1.aggregationNote: May be summed only across caller-proven disjoint scopes at the same point.

world-metric-definition_6864507216fdceee.name: Unemployed population
world-metric-definition_6864507216fdceee.description: Derived labor force minus employed population.
world-metric-definition_6864507216fdceee.aggregationNote: Derived from coherent same-scope labor-force and employed counts; never independently summed or written.

world-metric-definition_7efb05eee18af346.name: Unemployment rate
world-metric-definition_7efb05eee18af346.description: Derived unemployed population divided by labor force.
world-metric-definition_7efb05eee18af346.aggregationNote: Derived from coherent same-scope counts and cannot be summed or written independently.

world-metric-definition_a379ec7436ae0751.name: Aggregate labor income
world-metric-definition_a379ec7436ae0751.description: Exact aggregate labor-income proxy over an explicit interval.
world-metric-definition_a379ec7436ae0751.aggregationNote: May be summed only for the same currency, interval, and disjoint scopes.

world-metric-definition_2a7cb078dbc1a14a.name: Cost level
world-metric-definition_2a7cb078dbc1a14a.description: Exact aggregate price/cost index at a point in time.
world-metric-definition_2a7cb078dbc1a14a.aggregationNote: Index levels cannot be summed across scopes.

world-metric-definition_f2acf9698e80dd03.name: Aggregate consumption demand
world-metric-definition_f2acf9698e80dd03.description: Exact aggregate consumption/demand proxy over an interval.
world-metric-definition_f2acf9698e80dd03.aggregationNote: May be summed only for the same currency, interval, and disjoint scopes.

world-metric-definition_0e65b688cf9fcf57.name: Aggregate output activity
world-metric-definition_0e65b688cf9fcf57.description: Exact aggregate output/business-activity proxy over an interval.
world-metric-definition_0e65b688cf9fcf57.aggregationNote: May be summed only for the same currency, interval, and disjoint scopes.

world-metric-definition_c3dddbaa794b2988.name: Housing availability pressure
world-metric-definition_c3dddbaa794b2988.description: Exact aggregate housing availability/pressure index at a point.
world-metric-definition_c3dddbaa794b2988.aggregationNote: Pressure indexes cannot be summed across scopes.

world-metric-definition_8180dba2c4524249.name: Government revenue
world-metric-definition_8180dba2c4524249.description: Exact aggregate government revenue over an interval.
world-metric-definition_8180dba2c4524249.aggregationNote: May be summed only for the same currency, interval, and nonoverlapping fiscal scopes.

world-metric-definition_dade15c5237bd1da.name: Government outlays
world-metric-definition_dade15c5237bd1da.description: Exact aggregate government outlays over an interval.
world-metric-definition_dade15c5237bd1da.aggregationNote: May be summed only for the same currency, interval, and nonoverlapping fiscal scopes.

world-metric-definition_3de737c216cf149e.name: Government debt
world-metric-definition_3de737c216cf149e.description: Exact aggregate government debt outstanding at a point.
world-metric-definition_3de737c216cf149e.aggregationNote: Debt stocks require authority-aware consolidation and cannot be automatically summed.

world-metric-definition_5fdb99d26958c05c.name: Government fiscal balance
world-metric-definition_5fdb99d26958c05c.description: Derived revenue minus outlays for one scope, interval, and currency.
world-metric-definition_5fdb99d26958c05c.aggregationNote: Derived from same-scope, same-period, same-currency revenue and outlays; never independently written.
